pageCache.text:
Pray together, Learn Together, Stronger Together in Jesus
Welcome toSt Saviour's RC Primary School
A very warm welcome to St Saviour’s Roman Catholic Primary School, a place where children are at the heart of everything we do. We are an inclusive family school located in the heart of Lewisham.
At St Saviour’s, we pride ourselves on being a close-knit family school, a place where every child is known, valued and supported. Our staff are deeply committed to nurturing each child’s unique gifts and helping them grow into confident, compassionate and capable individuals.
Our school motto, “Pray Together, Learn Together, Stronger Together in Jesus”, captures the spirit of our community. This reflects our passion for creating a school where every child can thrive, grow in faith and achieve their very best. Our values of Courage, Respect and Unity shape daily life in our school community. They inspire our pupils to be brave in their learning, to treat others with kindness and dignity as well as to live in harmony with everyone.
We are passionate about helping every child reach their true potential spiritually, morally, academically, emotionally, socially, culturally and physically. We believe that each child is a unique gift from God and we strive to nurture their talents and character with care. St Saviour’s is a place where children feel safe, happy and celebrated for who they are. We value the essential partnership between home, school and parish and through all parties working together our children will be sure of success.
Thank you for visiting our website. We hope you feel the warmth and welcome that defines St Saviour’s when you visit or become part of our family school.
We look forward to welcoming you into our community.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Saviours RC Primary School - Mission Statement
pageCache.text:
Mission Statement
St Saviour's RC Primary School Mission Statement
At St Saviour's, we are passionate about ensuring that all children reach their true potential. We endeavour to place Jesus at the heart of all that we do:
"Pray Together, Learn Together, Stronger Together in Jesus"
Our Student Council worked on our values and we surveyed pupils, parents, staff and governors. We decided on the three main values of Courage, Respect and Unity. These values are based on the teachings from the Gospel.
Ethos and Values
Courage “Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.” Joshua 1:9
Respect “In your hearts, set apart Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have. But do this with gentleness and respect”. 1 Peter 3:15
Unity “A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.” John 13:34-35
The school strives to build on the foundations of faith started from the home and seeks to provide an environment where beliefs and values of the Catholic faith are taught, explained, developed and nurtured. Our School is a place where each child believes in their own potential, in an environment where they can succeed and achieve.
We place a high value on Catholic Social Teaching and weave it through all we do.
CATHOLIC SOCIAL TEACHING

pageCache.pageTitle: St Saviours RC Primary School - Welcome
pageCache.text:
We are a popular Roman Catholic Primary School situated in the heart of Lewisham Centre. We are committed to helping all the children in our care achieve their true potential, as we strive for excellence in all we do.
Our wonderful staff, children, families and governing body work hard to ensure we create a supportive, nurturing environment where every child can achieve their potential. Young children get off to an excellent start in Nursery, building up a very strong foundation of social skills and independence.
Alongside academic achievement we can offer your child a fantastic music provision, where in addition to curriculum lessons they have the opportunity to join our school choir or learn a range of musical instruments. We can also offer a specialist PE coach and Italian lessons as part of our diverse curriculum.
Our last Ofsted reported “Teachers move lessons along at a good pace, setting realistic timescales and motivating lively learning” and “Behaviour in lessons is invariably impeccable, meaning pupils can learn without interruption.”
Children achieve very well over time at St. Saviour’s, and our current Key Stage Two results are above the National Average and rising! Our successes also go far beyond test results. Our children are confident and happy and are regularly complimented on their behaviour, good manners and social skills. They are encouraged to challenge themselves, to develop their skills and talents to be the very best they can. We celebrate every success and support every need.
Father Krzysztof Father Mark
Parish Priest School Chaplin and Assistant Priest

Curriculum and Learning
RE
Our RE curriculum consists of the Come and See scheme. This interweaves themes and stories from the Bible and allows children to understand their own spirituality and Catholicism.
English
We have a very exciting book based English curriculum. The books inspire the writing and reflect the diversity of our local area.
Literacy Tree English
Maths
We use the White Rose scheme of maths to ensure progression of skills and a great mix between arithmetic and problem solving.
Humanities including Science
Our exciting humanities curriculum allows children to enjoy history, geography, science, computing, art and DT in a meaningful way that links together.
Computer Science
An overview of the skills covered in each year group and strand and how these skills develop through our Computing scheme of work.This document also shows how knowledge builds in our key areas.

Extra Curricular Activities
At St Saviour’s R.C Primary School, we ensure that all our pupils have the opportunity to develop their skills with our exciting after school clubs. Led by professional coaches, the clubs offer children with varied interests the chance to develop their skills in familiar and comfortable surroundings.
All of the Clubs run from 3.30-4.30pm.
Club prices are from 6.00 per session and £3.00 per session to those children in receipt of Pupil Premium.

Academic Results
At the end of Reception, the Early Years team at St. Saviour’s RC Primary School make a judgement as to whether children have reached a good level of development (GLD) in the early learning goals in the prime areas of learning (personal, social and emotional development; physical development; and communication and language) and the early learning goals in the specific areas of Mathematics and Literacy.
To find out more information on the Early Years foundation stage profile results.
https://explore-education-statistics.service.gov.uk/find-statistics/early-years-foundation-stage-profile-results

Class 1 & 2 Phonics Data
In Class 1, children are tested in Phonics. The pass mark is 32 out of 40. Children who do not pass are re-tested in Class 2.
To find out more information about the Phonics Screening Scheck, click here:
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/phonics-screening-check-information-for-parents

KS1 Results 2024
The KS1 Standard Assessment Tests [SATs] are now non-statutory [from September 2023]. As a result, the children at St. Saviour’s RC Primary School will not be sitting these exams. We will use our own assessments to consistently measure outcomes in line with the rest of our school.
KS2 SATS Results 2024
In Class 6, children complete KS2 SATs. A child will only count successfully towards a school's score if they pass in Reading, Writing and Maths. As a result, results can vary from year to year with some children missing from the combined percentage in perhaps just one subject.
To find out more information about the Class 6 SATs, click here:

The phonics screening check is taken individually by all children in Year 1. This is a national assessment that takes place in June.
